decision_cruda.rationale: LH-03 is repaired in place, likely by 09:54 (range 09:45-10:00), and radio and CMMS agree. N574-02 has 201 t (about 68 oz). LH-03 can muck it in about 5.6 h at 35.6 t/h, and about 6.5 h remain before 17:00, so the ore is not at risk. Norte is already truck-limited (inflow 71 t/h against 66 t/h truck capacity), so an extra loader adds little. Any loan would cost travel time and take production or development from another place. Do nothing.

LH-03 is down at N574-02 until about 15:30 or later, because the part is not in stock. That stope has 201 t at 10.5 g/t, about 68 oz. LH-10 comes out of preventive maintenance at 11:00 and takes 0.62 h to get there. It has no home place, so lending it costs nothing. It loads at 25.4 t/h from about 11:40 to 17:00, roughly 135 t or 46 oz. Norte is nearly truck-limited, with 245 of 450 t in the stockpile. One extra loader keeps the stockpile under capacity. A second loader (LH-08) would fill the stockpile and only displace higher-grade Norte ore, so I left it on its heading.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
